source_type: Owner-maintained public GitHub data bridge; not an independently authenticated DrivenData download
official_data_tab_login_requirement: The local project records the DrivenData data tab as login-gated; this session restored only the pinned owner mirror.
integrity_conclusion: All five part hashes and the whole-file SHA-256 match the owner-maintained bridge pins; Rasterio opened the file and read its 19-band header.
provenance_limit: Matching a mirror's own hashes proves byte integrity relative to that mirror. It does not prove the bytes came unchanged from the competition's authenticated data tab.
cache_persistence: Outside the repository and excluded from Git snapshots. Re-run scripts/fetch_feature_stack.sh in a future session if the cache is absent.
experiment_use: No feature was evaluated and no holdout experiment was run because the literal uniqueness stop blocks the current artifact before candidate qualification.
